name: smart-locker-system
description: Smart Locker Room Management System — Hardware + Software Integration

scripts.dev: npx concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.start: npx concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm --prefix backend start" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
